task_description.overview: Align the waveforms of phase onsets from two seismic events to correct the original pick times by fitting a parabola around the maximum of the cross-correlation function.
steps: Load seismic waveform data for two events (st1 and st2) from the provided paths.
Select the Z-component traces (tr1 and tr2) for analysis.
Define the original pick times t1 and t2 for the two events.
Call xcorr_pick_correction with parameters: pre_trigger, post_trigger, cc_maxlag, and optional plotting and filter settings.
Fit a parabola around the peak of the cross-correlation function to determine the time shift (dt).
Record the correlation coefficient (coeff) and apply the time correction to the second pick.

task_definition.agent_prompt: You are given two seismic traces (trace1 and trace2) and their original pick times (pick_time1 and pick_time2). Apply cross-correlation pick correction using given parameters. Compute the time correction dt and correlation coefficient coeff. Plot the cross-correlation functions and the time correction result. Save the result to {result.save_name} with content {result.content} and the plot to {result_plot}.
